endorsements.name: Nils Ole Tippenhauer
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-9506
endorsements.description: The Bluetooth BR/EDR specification up to and including version 5.1 permits sufficiently low encryption key length and does not prevent an attacker from influencing the key length negotiation. This allows practical brute-force attacks (aka "KNOB") that can decrypt traffic and inject arbitrary ciphertext without the victim noticing.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 7.6)
